# Pixel Path

Turn any two places (optionally via waypoints) into a pixel-art fly-through of the real road: it routes the trip, bakes the real buildings, land cover, landmarks, hills and horizon from OpenStreetMap and elevation data, generates scenery art at a level of detail you choose (free placeholder art, or paid RetroDiffusion art quoted exactly and capped by a budget you confirm first), and builds a page where you zoom along the route and scroll to go faster or slower, with a screenshot self-check.
